instruction: A candid wedding photograph, medium shot at eye-level with a shallow depth of field. In an elegant indoor hotel lobby with potted plants and grey sofas in the background, the woman with curly hair in a white one-shoulder dress (R1) stands on the left, facing right and looking down. The woman in a white pantsuit (R2) stands on the right, facing left and holding a bouquet of pink peonies in her left hand. They smile warmly as they extend their hands to clasp each other's fingers in the center of the frame. Soft, natural light fills the space, creating a warm and serene atmosphere with neutral tones.
